settings.hero_heading: What the shop does besides fit your tires
settings.hero_lede: Extreme Tires works on cars in Sunrise every day. [mobile_count] of these services travel to you in a van; brakes, alignment, suspension and lift kits need a lift and a rack, so those happen in the bay.
settings.notice_text: TireDrop ships tires to the continental United States. Everything on this page happens in South Florida — at the Sunrise shop or in your driveway.
settings.legend_mobile: The van comes to your home, office or jobsite
settings.legend_shop: Performed at 7712 West Oakland Park Blvd, Sunrise
settings.where_mobile: Local service — the van performs this at your home, office or jobsite anywhere in the South Florida install area, or you bring the vehicle to Sunrise.
settings.where_shop: In-shop only — this one needs a lift and bay equipment, so it happens at 7712 West Oakland Park Blvd, Sunrise.
settings.copy_tires: Fitting the set you ordered, and everything that happens between your wheel and the road afterwards.
settings.copy_wheels: Fitment, mounting and balancing for the wheel package you bought.
settings.copy_maintenance: Routine work that keeps the miles cheap — in the bay or in your own parking spot.
settings.copy_repair: Bay work at the Sunrise shop, where the lifts and the alignment rack live.
settings.copy_custom: Lift and leveling packages built around the tire and wheel setup you want.
settings.sym_lede: You do not have to know the name of the repair. Pick the thing your vehicle is actually doing and we will match it to the fix.
settings.sym_empty_text: Choose the symptom that sounds closest to what you are dealing with and we will point you at the right service. Nothing matching? Call us at [phone] and describe it — we have heard it before.

settings.book_text: Send us your service, your vehicle and your window through the booking request form — or call and talk it through with a dispatcher. Booking a fitting for tires on their way here? Say so in the notes.
settings.tires_text: Choose free ship-to-store at checkout and they land here on the rack with your name on them — then book the fitting around your week instead of around a delivery.

settings.name: Tire Installation
settings.blurb: Mount and install new tires at your home, office or jobsite — no waiting room, no tow.
settings.includes:
Dismount and disposal of old tires
Mount and seat new tires on your wheels
Road-force-style balance on every wheel
Valve stem replacement
Torque to manufacturer spec
TPMS reset where equipped
settings.symptoms:
Tread worn to the wear bars
Tires older than six years
Sidewall cracking or bulging

settings.name: Tire Balancing
settings.blurb: Kill the steering-wheel shimmy. Precision balancing performed in your driveway.
settings.includes:
Wheel weight removal and cleanup
Dynamic balance on a calibrated spin balancer
Re-torque to spec
Road test on request
settings.symptoms:
Steering wheel vibration above 45 mph
Seat or floor buzz at highway speed
Uneven cupped tread wear

settings.name: Tire Repair
settings.blurb: Nail in your tread? We patch-plug it properly from the inside — the proper way.
settings.includes:
Dismount and internal inspection
Combination patch-plug repair
Rebalance after repair
Pressure set to door-placard spec
settings.symptoms:
Slow leak or repeat low-pressure warnings
Visible nail, screw or puncture
Tire that will not hold air overnight

settings.name: Tire Rotation
settings.blurb: Even out wear and add thousands of miles to your set. Recommended every 5,000–7,500 miles.
settings.includes:
Pattern rotation matched to your drivetrain
Tread depth measured at every corner
Pressure correction
Torque to spec
settings.symptoms:
Front tires wearing faster than rear
It has been over 7,500 miles
Noise that changes with vehicle speed

settings.name: Wheel Installation
settings.blurb: New wheels mounted, balanced and fitted with hub-centric rings for a true, vibration-free ride.
settings.includes:
Fitment and clearance verification
Mount and balance
Hub-centric ring fitment
Correct lug hardware check
TPMS transfer or programming
settings.symptoms:
Upgrading to aftermarket wheels
Bent or curbed wheel replacement
Seasonal wheel and tire swap

settings.name: Oil Change
settings.blurb: Full-synthetic oil and a new filter while your car sits in its own parking spot.
settings.includes:
Up to 5 quarts full-synthetic oil
New oil filter
Fluid top-off
Multi-point visual inspection
Used oil removed and recycled
settings.symptoms:
Maintenance-required light on
Over 5,000 miles since last change
Oil dark on the dipstick

settings.name: TPMS Service
settings.blurb: Diagnose, reset or replace the pressure sensors behind that stubborn dashboard light.
settings.includes:
Sensor scan and battery health check
Sensor replacement where needed
Relearn and programming to your vehicle
Pressure set to placard spec
settings.symptoms:
TPMS light stays on after inflating
TPMS light flashing at startup
Sensor damaged during a prior install

settings.name: Brake Repair
settings.blurb: Pads, rotors and full hydraulic diagnosis by technicians who do it every day.
settings.includes:
Pad and rotor measurement
Caliper and slide pin service
Hardware and shim replacement
Brake fluid inspection
Road test and bed-in
settings.symptoms:
Squealing or grinding when stopping
Pedal pulsation under braking
Longer stopping distances

settings.name: Wheel Alignment
settings.blurb: Four-wheel computerized alignment that stops your new tires wearing out early.
settings.includes:
Camber, caster and toe measurement
Adjustment to factory spec
Steering wheel centering
Before-and-after printout
settings.symptoms:
Car pulls to one side
Steering wheel off-center on a straight road
Feathered or one-sided tire wear

settings.name: Suspension Repair
settings.blurb: Struts, shocks, bushings and control arms — the parts that keep your tires on the road.
settings.includes:
Full suspension inspection
Strut and shock replacement
Bushing and control arm service
Alignment check after repair
settings.symptoms:
Bouncy or floaty ride
Clunking over bumps
Nose dive when braking

settings.name: Lift Kits
settings.blurb: Leveling kits through full suspension lifts, spec'd around the tire and wheel package you want.
settings.includes:
Fitment consultation
Kit installation
Driveline angle check
Post-install alignment
Torque re-check appointment
settings.symptoms:
Want more ground clearance
Fitting oversized tires
Correcting factory rake

settings.name: Diagnostics & Inspections
settings.blurb: Check engine light scan and a straight answer about what it will actually cost to fix.
settings.includes:
Full OBD-II code scan
Live data review
Visual under-hood inspection
Written findings and estimate
settings.symptoms:
Check engine light on
Rough idle or hesitation
Unexplained drop in fuel economy
